problems.issue: Missing local business structured data (Schema.org Dentists or LocalBusiness)
problems.impact: Reduces local SEO visibility and rich snippet opportunities in search engine results pages.

problems.issue: Google Maps directions link points to a generalized search URL rather than specific geo-coordinates or a precise place ID
problems.impact: Increases friction for patients trying to navigate to the Manila branch.

opportunities: Implement Schema.org local business markup to improve local search engine rankings.
Replace the Google Search fallback URL with a direct Google Maps Place ID link for better mobile user experience.
audit.summary: The DR Smile Dental Clinic landing page hosted on Molarsoft provides essential branch details, booking, and queue management functions. However, optimization can be improved by adding structured schema markup and more precise map navigation links.

outreach.subject: Quick thought on DR Smile Manila's site
outreach.body:
Hi there,

I was looking over the DR Smile landing page for the Manila branch and appreciate how straightforward you've made booking and queue management for patients.

While reviewing the page, I noticed a couple of quick fixes that could make a big difference: adding local business schema markup to help you stand out more in search results, and updating the map link with precise coordinates so patients don't run into friction finding the clinic.

We actually put together a quick, live demo showing these improvements in action. Would it be useful if I sent it over?

Best,
Rahul

---
If you'd prefer not to hear from me again, just reply 'unsubscribe' and I'll remove you right away.
